title: Halftone sculpture
description: A turning organic relief is translated into cobalt ink dots on uncoated paper.
useCase: Art publications, exhibition identities, editorial portfolios, and print-led motion branding.
interaction: Play or pause the material study.
reducedMotion: Displays one stable, representative frame. Responds immediately when the system preference changes.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1; a static CSS composition remains visible when WebGL is unavailable or lost. An analytic relief with moving light, not a full 3D mesh. Fine ink dots may alias when the canvas is downscaled.
look: Warm uncoated off-white paper with a cobalt-blue halftone dot blob, a heavy blue sans headline bottom-left, small spaced monospace labels and a serif numeral.
motion: The three-lobed relief slowly rotates (about 84 s per turn) while the light swings side to side every 29 s, so halftone dots continuously grow and shrink with the shading.
adapt: Everything is in `FRAGMENT`: `heightAt` defines the rotating relief (`u_time * .075`), `lamp` the moving light, `spacing` the dot pitch and `inkRadius` the dot size. Swap `paper` and the ink colour, and replace the overlay copy.
